title: Ezra Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Ezra 5: Haggai and Zechariah prophesy, the building resumes, and Tattenai writes to Darius the king.

questions.text: Which prophets prophesied to the Jews in Judah and Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo prophesied to the Jews in the name of the God of Israel.

questions.text: Who rose up and began to build God's house at Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak rose up and began to build God's house.

questions.text: What did Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, ask them?
questions.explanation: Tattenai asked them, "Who gave you a decree to build this house, and to finish this wall?"

answers.text: Why they had not paid their tribute
Where the temple vessels were kept
Who gave them a decree to build this house

questions.text: Why did Tattenai and his companions not make the elders stop?
questions.explanation: The eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, and they didn't make them cease until the matter should come to Darius.

answers.text: The elders paid them a large bribe
The eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews
They did not have enough soldiers

questions.text: According to Tattenai's letter, how was the house of the great God being built?
questions.explanation: They wrote that it was built with great stones, and timber was laid in the walls.

answers.text: With burnt bricks and bitumen for mortar
With cedar wood overlaid with pure gold
With great stones, and timber laid in the walls
With mud bricks mixed with straw

questions.text: How did the elders describe themselves in their answer?
questions.explanation: They answered, "We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth."

answers.text: The servants of the God of heaven and earth
The servants of Darius the king

questions.text: According to the elders, who had first built and finished the house many years ago?
questions.explanation: They said they were building the house that was built many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and finished.

questions.text: According to the answer the builders gave, who destroyed the house?
questions.explanation: They said God gave their fathers into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house.

questions.text: To whom were the gold and silver vessels delivered by Cyrus?
questions.explanation: Cyrus took the vessels out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered to Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor.

answers.text: Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor

questions.text: Where did Tattenai ask the king to have a search made?
questions.explanation: They asked that a search be made in the king's treasure house at Babylon, whether Cyrus had made a decree to build this house.

answers.text: In the king's treasure house at Babylon
In the house of the high priest
